title: SmellieTotems
description: A resource pack to replace the totem of undying with Streamer and VTuber Smellizabeth
body:
This resource pack has special named totems. Name your totem `Guppie` or `Guppie Doll` for the cyan variants and `Smellie` or `Smellie Doll` for the normal variants.

The doll variants are rotated in item frames so that they stand up if placed on the ground.
